allow: Committing and pushing directly to the default branch `master` of this repository is intended and approved by the owner, for documentation and agent configuration only: `docs/`, `CLAUDE.md`, `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `REVIEW.md`, `DEPLOY.md`, `content/STYLE.md` and `.claude/`. The owner decided on 5 September 2026 that documentation does not go through pull requests, because the merge gate exists to guard what is published and a document is not published. Treat such a push as routine.

Changes to the code and content of the site itself (`app/`, `frontend/`, `scripts/`, `config/`, `tests/`, `content/indicators/`, `content/posts/`, `migrations/`) still go on a branch and through a pull request: the merge is the human gate, and for divarioitalia the merge is the publication. A direct push of those to `master` is NOT covered by the rule above.
